module.title: Disk and file checker
module.description: CheckDisk can check various file and disk related things.
module.name: CheckDisk

commands.check_drivesize: Check the size (free-space) of a drive or volume.
commands.check_files: Check various aspects of a file and/or folder.

check_single_file.description: Check various aspects of a single file (size, age, line count, version, ...). Simpler alternative to check_files when you only need to inspect one specific file.

check_disk_io.description: Check disk I/O performance metrics (throughput, IOPS, queue length, busy time).

check_disk_write.description: Verify that a disk is writable by creating a test file, writing to it, reading it back and deleting it.

check_disk_health.description: Combined per-drive health check (free space + I/O metrics).

check_uncpath.description: Check free space on a UNC path (server share), with optional alternate credentials.

check_storagepool.description: Check Storage Spaces pool health and capacity. Windows only.

check_shadowcopy.description: Check VSS shadow-copy (Volume Shadow Copy) recency, count and shadow-storage usage per volume. Windows only.

check_share.description: Check Windows SMB shares: list them, or verify that specific required shares exist. Windows only.

check_mount.description: Check that a filesystem is mounted with the expected fstype and options.
